AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA, hovering within 1.5% of its 104.09 pivot on 1.46x average volume with positive MACD momentum.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals are deteriorating sharply, with Q1 revenue contracting 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.5% YoY. Subdued multi-year ROE of ~3% fails CANSLIM filters despite low debt.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below the 95.67 stop loss. Negative earnings and falling revenue leave the stock vulnerable to severe selling.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-session high at 933.53 on massive 4.62x volume expansion. RSI at 64 shows constructive momentum without overextension.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Strong quarterly performance with net profit surging 53.8% YoY and sales expanding 38.7% YoY. Healthy operating margins near 20% and moderate leverage support the setup.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis invalid below 849.72 stop. Re-entering the prior consolidation range would confirm a false breakout in a weak tape.

ABDL.technical: Displays heavy volume (5.43x 20-day average) near its 712.41 pivot, holding well above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages with bullish MACD alignment.
ABDL.fundamental: Operational growth remains sluggish as Q1 net profit contracted 13% YoY and sales inched up only 1.9% YoY. High debtor days (168 days) further pressure liquidity.
ABDL.risk: Violated if price slides under 671.04. Negative earnings growth caps setup quality to Watch under CANSLIM rules.

ACE.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 1269.27 pivot, sustained above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD above signal and swing low support.
ACE.fundamental: Solid industrial demand drove Q1 standalone sales up 18.9% YoY and net profit up 22.3% YoY. EBITDA margins hold above 20% alongside negligible balance sheet leverage.
ACE.risk: Thesis breaks below 1178.43. Overhead market selling could stall momentum at the neckline pivot.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Double bottom base pressing the 477.38 neckline pivot. Holds firmly above 21/50/200 moving averages; RSI at 71 reflects strong relative strength during market decline.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Turnaround characteristics evident as Q1 revenue jumped 67.9% YoY and EPS surged 50% YoY. Renewable generation expansion improves cash flow, though capital intensity keeps debt high.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below 436.05. Capital-intensive project execution carries sensitivity to broader risk-off liquidation.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Constructive Stage 2 structure above rising 21, 50, and 200 MAs, hovering within 1.5% of 1892.99 pivot. RSI at 69 reflects steady institutional accumulation.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Volume expansion drove Q1 revenue up 18.6% YoY and EBITDA up 19%. However, net profit growth decelerated to 9.2% YoY, capping CANSLIM momentum.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Stop triggers below 1812.38. Decelerating earnings growth prevents a leadership rating under strict CANSLIM C+A criteria.
